headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of November 19, 2026, the portfolio has delivered an average return of 7.65%, exceeding the SPY benchmark return of 5.64% by 2.01%. This outperformance indicates that the portfolio is effectively navigating the current market environment, which can be particularly valuable during times of macro uncertainty or volatility. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 34.24%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned -3.12%, highlighting the variability within the portfolio set. The average alpha of 2.01% further emphasizes that the portfolio is not only growing but also outperforming its benchmark. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
